root_cause.detail: The admitted RaidRuntime refresh worked live: alive_size moved from ten through partial deaths to zero and wipe/reset generations advanced. While the route remained generation 3/index 2 on the two entry-42362 Drudges, Hunter GUID 1279 submitted Multi-Shot 2643 at Drudge GUID 60; the next retained cohort tick was the first to include Magmaw GUID 39 in every threat snapshot and boss state IN_PROGRESS. Fire Mage GUID 1276 then submitted Living Bomb 44457 directly to Magmaw while its declared route focus remained Drudge 60. A later native replacement Magmaw GUID 404 repeated the contamination. The route never advanced, but standalone wipe and boss-reset generations kept resetting the uncapped semantic-progress clock.
root_cause.decision_assessment: Current-node target selection remained on the Drudges, but implicit chain/area/multidot selection escaped that authority and pulled/continued the next encounter. This is a bot decision and capture-liveness defect, not a Magmaw script or gameplay failure. The fix must reject direct future-encounter targets, reject native-data chain/area reach that can hit the protected next encounter, hold all offensive sources after premature engagement, and count only durable route/boss progress or independently observed native-recovery milestones.
remediation_scope: centralize immediate-next boss and declared-add identity
reject direct and Living-Bomb-spread selection of protected future encounter members
derive chain and area reach from native SpellInfo data and reject unsafe profile candidates
interrupt and hold bot, pet, controlled, channel and autorepeat offense after premature encounter linkage
remove wipe/reset/recovery counters as standalone watchdog progress
retain one-time native death/corpse/release/runback/resurrection/ready-check milestones as legitimate progress
mandatory independent Sol-high review, exact rebuild, fresh reprovision, and uncapped rerun

acceptance.reason: The refreshed runtime was live, but current trash decisions prematurely engaged Magmaw and repeated reset churn masked a stuck route; no complete native recovery or ready-check sequence was accepted.
acceptance.next_gate: Mandatory independent Sol-high review of the target-authority and watchdog remediation, exact coordinated rebuild, fresh provisioning/full verifier/v4 readback, and uncapped canonical rerun.
